jd.job_title: Senior Robotics Software Engineer, Simulation & Evaluation
required_skills: Simulation platforms (Isaac Sim, Gazebo, MuJoCo, Unity, Unreal, or custom robotics simulators)
ROS2 / similar robotics middleware (sensors, transforms, logs, timing)
Robot or simulation assets (URDF, SDF, meshes, dynamics, sensor models)
Ability to debug simulator-to-robot gaps (sensing, timing, dynamics, autonomy behavior)
3+ years experience developing robotics simulation tools, simulation infrastructure, autonomy evaluation, or related robotics software
preferred_skills: Simulator plugins, custom sensor models, physics extensions, terrain/contact models, environment authoring tools
Large-scale batch simulation, CI-based regression testing, deterministic replay, scenario evaluation infrastructure
Experience using real-world robot data to validate, tune, or improve simulation models
Software-in-the-loop, hardware-in-the-loop, log replay, simulation correlation
Legged robots, humanoids, field robotics, or robots in unstructured environments
Experience with Isaac Sim, Omniverse, USD, PhysX, ROS2, Docker, CMake, Bazel, or GitHub Actions
key_responsibilities: Maintain, refactor, and improve internal robotics simulation tools and infrastructure
Improve simulation fidelity for autonomy evaluation (robot behavior, sensor modeling, timing, terrain interaction, environment representation)
Build workflows for scenario execution, log replay, regression testing, metrics, and visualization
Develop real-to-sim workflows turning field logs, reconstructed environments, and failure cases into reproducible simulation scenarios
Debug gaps between simulated and real robot behavior across sensing, timing, dynamics, autonomy
Improve developer workflows around simulation performance, reproducibility, debugging, and test automation
Contribute to long-term simulation strategy for legged robots and humanoids in complex real-world environments

have: C++ and Python software engineering (Profile lists Python, C/C++ in skills; Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm uses Python (Flask) + C (Arduino embedded); ROS arm uses Python + C/C++; CUDA C++ kernel optimization project; custom Cython BPE tokenizer; STM32 bare-metal embedded C)
ROS2 / robotics middleware (ROS-Based Robotic Arm: ROS2 Humble + ROS Noetic, MoveIt, RViz, UR ROS2 driver; Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm uses ROS2 middleware implicitly; skills list ROS2 explicitly)

Sensor integration and modeling (real hardware) (Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm: dual VL53L0X ToF sensors, TCA9548A I2C mux, UART/I2C; Object Tracking Turret: VL53L0X ToF + STM32 UART; STM32 bare-metal: timer-triggered ADC, I2C driver; embedded systems internship: ADXL345 + Bluetooth HC-05; embedded skills cover SPI/I2C/UART/Bluetooth)

Real robot deployment and integration debugging (Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (capstone): 100% pick reliability (10/10), resolved 11 integration failures between AI pipeline (STT, intent, YOLO) and physical sensors/actuators, deployed on real Jetson + Arduino hardware with systemd)

Simulation / simulator-like environment experience (Autonomous Driving in CARLA: semantic segmentation, YOLO11n + UFLD lane detection, zero collisions in Town02; uses a robotics simulator for autonomy evaluation scenario execution)
CMake and build tools (Profile skills list includes CMake explicitly)

Custom kernel/model optimization and low-level engineering (CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16: custom CUDA C++ kernels, memory coalescing, 35% speedup; SLM Compression: 8-bit quantization bitsandbytes; custom Cython tokenizer; embedded C drivers)
